description: Map HEMO topology, measure Q432-to-membrane distance, furin consensus scan, hydropathy TM check, and stalk-geometry comparison to canonical ADAM substrates
code:
import requests, json, re, os
import numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt

j = requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/Q9H9K5.json", timeout=60).json()
seq = j['sequence']['value']; N=len(seq)
os.makedirs('/tmp/prov', exist_ok=True); json.dump(j, open('/tmp/prov/q9h9k5.json','w'))
SP_END, TM_START, TM_END, Q = 26, 489, 509, 432

print("Q432 =", seq[431], " R433 =", seq[432], " Q434 =", seq[433])
print("TM 489-509 =", seq[488:509])
print("Cyto tail 510-563 (len %d) = %s" % (563-510+1, seq[509:563]))

stalk = seq[432:488]
print(f"\n[1] P1 (Q432) -> first TM residue (489): {TM_START-Q} residues")
print(f"    retained membrane stub stalk 433-488 ({len(stalk)} aa): {stalk}")

print("\n[2] Cleavage context (P6..P1 | P1'..P6')")
print("  Q432/R433 :", seq[426:432], "|", seq[432:438])
print("  R433/Q434 :", seq[427:433], "|", seq[433:439])
print("  P4 P3 P2 P1 | P1' P2' P3' P4' =", " ".join(seq[428:432]), "|", " ".join(seq[432:436]))

print("\n[3] Furin consensus scan over the full 563-aa chain")
strict  = [(m.start()+1, seq[m.start():m.start()+4]) for m in re.finditer(r'(?=R.[KR]R)', seq)]
minimal = [(m.start()+1, seq[m.start():m.start()+4]) for m in re.finditer(r'(?=R..R)', seq)]
print("  strict  R-X-[KR]-R :", strict  if strict  else "NONE")
print("  minimal R-X-X-R    :", minimal if minimal else "NONE")
print("  P4-P1 at mapped site (429-432) =", seq[428:432], "| R at P4?", seq[428]=='R', "| basic at P1?", seq[431] in 'KR')

kd = {'A':1.8,'R':-4.5,'N':-3.5,'D':-3.5,'C':2.5,'Q':-3.5,'E':-3.5,'G':-0.4,'H':-3.2,
      'I':4.5,'L':3.8,'K':-3.9,'M':1.9,'F':2.8,'P':-1.6,'S':-0.8,'T':-0.7,'W':-0.9,'Y':-1.3,'V':4.2}
w=19
h = np.array([np.mean([kd[a] for a in seq[i:i+w]]) for i in range(N-w+1)])
centers = np.arange(N-w+1)+w//2+1
print("\n[4] Kyte-Doolittle w=19, independent hydrophobic-segment check")
seen=[]
for o in np.argsort(h)[::-1]:
    c=int(centers[o])
    if all(abs(c-s)>15 for s in seen):
        seen.append(c); print(f"    center {c:>4}  <KD>={h[o]:5.2f}  {seq[max(0,c-11):c+10]}")
    if len(seen)==4: break

fig, axes = plt.subplots(2,1, figsize=(12.5,8.5), gridspec_kw={'height_ratios':[2,1.1]})
ax=axes[0]
ax.plot(centers, h, lw=1.2, color='#2b6cb0')
ax.axhline(1.6, ls=':', color='grey', lw=1)
ax.axvspan(1, SP_END, color='#f6ad55', alpha=.45, label='signal peptide 1-26 (experimental)')
ax.axvspan(TM_START, TM_END, color='#fc8181', alpha=.55, label='transmembrane 489-509')
ax.axvspan(433, 488, color='#9ae6b4', alpha=.5, label='retained stalk 433-488 (56 aa)')
ax.axvline(432.5, color='k', lw=2, label='mapped cleavage Q432 / R433')
ax.set_xlabel('residue'); ax.set_ylabel('Kyte-Doolittle hydropathy (w=19)')
ax.set_title('Q9H9K5 HEMO topology: the mapped shedding site lies 56 residues from the membrane')
ax.legend(fontsize=8, loc='upper left'); ax.set_xlim(1,N)

ax=axes[1]
subs=[('TNF-alpha / ADAM17',12),('TGF-alpha / ADAM17',9),('APP / ADAM10',12),
      ('Notch1 S2 / ADAM10',12),('IL-6R / ADAM17',10),('CX3CL1 / ADAM10-17',8),
      ('L-selectin / ADAM17',11),('HEMO Q432 (mapped)',56)]
ax.barh([s[0] for s in subs],[s[1] for s in subs], color=['#90cdf4']*7+['#e53e3e'])
ax.axvspan(0,20,color='grey',alpha=.15)
ax.set_xlabel('residues between scissile bond (P1) and first TM residue')
ax.set_title('Juxtamembrane stalk geometry: HEMO site is far outside the ADAM10/17 window')
for i,s in enumerate(subs): ax.text(s[1]+1,i,str(s[1]),va='center',fontsize=8)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
